notes.li: Magic Framework 1.4.0 expands the first-party authoring surface with planar travel support, temporary allegiance effects, magical disease/treatment support, temporary wall spawning, and mining actions.
Maintained spell warmups, generated spell details, and temporary faction handling have been hardened for the new MF Vanilla content.
The main player-facing changes are in MF Vanilla 0.9.0: Planar Magic, Forbidden Lore spells, Geomancy utility spells, Cure Disease, and validated enchanted weapon behavior.
You can reopen the latest notes from the Magic Framework or MF Vanilla settings pages.
